Alex T: Quick sync for AWS/GCP/Azure listing kickoff. Need owners for publisher creds, branding assets, and legal artifacts. Can we triage now?
Maria (Partnerships): I can own publisher portal provisioning and creds. Need IAM role list and cloud account contacts.
Sara - PM: I'll handle packaging: trial SKU, pricing tiers, quickstart, description.
Kevin - Legal: I'll own EULA/privacy addendum. Any marketplace-specific telemetry language?
Maria (Partnerships): @Kevin should we include telemetry opt-out and data-retention blurb for the marketplaces?
Kevin - Legal: Yes. I'll draft a short telemetry opt-out clause + contact info and post to the ticket by EOD.
Alex T: Assets needed: logo (SVG + 300x300 PNG), 1-line blurb, 250-word description, 2 screenshots. Where to upload?
Maria (Partnerships): Upload to s3://redwood-partner-assets/marketplace/redwood-inference/. Naming: redwood-inference_logo_300.png, redwood-inference_banner.svg.
Sara - PM: Proposed trial: 14 days with 10k token credit, single-seat. Will draft listing copy and quickstart snippet.
Marketplace Bot: Ticket created MKP-4821 assigned Maria,Sara,Kevin due 2024-05-03.
Maria (Partnerships): Cloud contacts: AWS priya@aws-partners, GCP jon.gcp@partners, Azure carlos@azuremarketplace. Requesting publisher roles today.
Alex T: Need billing SKU mapping from finance for each marketplace. Maria please loop Finance into MKP-4821.
Maria (Partnerships): Looping finance now.
Kevin - Legal: Draft EULA + addendum will be in the ticket before EOD; will ping legal-ops.
Sara - PM: One blocker: need a Dedicated Capacity console screenshot from Eng for the listing page.
Alex T: Thanks all — target: publisher portal access, assets, and legal by Friday so onboarding can start next Tuesday. I'll update MKP-4821 timeline. :rocket:
